versions.changelog:
GRC Maturity Assessment Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release providing a comprehensive Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) maturity evaluation platform.
- Supports generating detailed assessment reports with maturity levels, gap analysis, and prioritized recommendations.
- Offers standardized maturity level definitions and GRC building block frameworks.
- Includes API endpoints for assessments, maturity levels, and building blocks.
- Multiple pricing plans available, including a free tier.
